# ELIMINATE-SUPERSEDED-GENERATION-ARTIFACTS (Eliminate, upstream: xaas/ggen_igniter)

## Evidence

### 1. Two xaas ggen_igniter packs target the same generated file, uncollisioned

Verified in this session by reading the repo directly (`~/xaas`):

- `~/xaas/priv/packs/xaas_ocel_envelope_pack/templates/ocel_envelope.ex.eex:2`
  declares `to: "lib/xaas/telemetry/ocel_envelope.ex"`.
- `~/xaas/priv/packs/xaas_telemetry_pack/templates/ocel_envelope.ex.eex:1-4`
  generates the same target module, `Xaas.Telemetry.OcelEnvelope`, into the
  same path (`lib/xaas/telemetry/ocel_envelope.ex`), with its own generation
  banner:
  ```
  # GENERATED by ggen_igniter from priv/packs/xaas_telemetry_pack/ontology.ttl.
  # Do not edit directly. Regenerate with:
  #   mix ggen_igniter.sync --pack-dir priv/packs/xaas_telemetry_pack --template priv/packs/xaas_telemetry_pack/templates/ocel_envelope.ex.eex --out lib/xaas/telemetry/ocel_envelope.ex
  ```
- Directory listing confirms both packs exist side by side with no
  cross-reference or deprecation marker between them:
  `~/xaas/priv/packs/{xaas_ocel_envelope_pack,xaas_telemetry_pack,xaas_library_pack}`.
- Neither pack's manifest or template contains any warning, `deprecated`
  marker, or pointer to the other pack. Whichever pack runs second in a
  `mix ggen_igniter.sync` invocation silently overwrites the first pack's
  output at `lib/xaas/telemetry/ocel_envelope.ex` — there is no build-time
  signal that a collision occurred.

This confirms the source material's claim: one pack is dead, one is live,
and nothing in the repository flags the collision.

### 2. `~/ggen_igniter/doc/gaps-to-fill-v26-9-1.md` gap #8 is stale against the code

Verified in this session by reading `~/ggen_igniter` directly (not re-derived
from the prior research pass, since this repo is accessible in this run):

- `~/ggen_igniter/doc/gaps-to-fill-v26-9-1.md:7` opens a "STATUS PASS
  (2026-09-01)" block claiming to be cross-checked against current code.
- `~/ggen_igniter/doc/gaps-to-fill-v26-9-1.md:52-53` states:
  > `DoctorFixes.rewrite_dep_only/2` crashes on a valid 2-tuple dep shape —
  > **OPEN, unaddressed**. `lib/ggen_igniter/doctor_fixes.ex:359` still calls
  > ...

- But `~/ggen_igniter/lib/ggen_igniter/doctor_fixes.ex:357` (`defp
  rewrite_dep_only(source, dep) do`) calls a helper `dep_opts_elem/1`
  (defined at `doctor_fixes.ex:400-409`) that inspects the real tuple arity
  via `Sourceror.Zipper` before picking which index to read:
  ```elixir
  defp dep_opts_elem(tuple_zipper) do
    case tuple_zipper
         |> Igniter.Code.Common.maybe_move_to_single_child_block()
         |> Sourceror.Zipper.node() do
      {:{}, _meta, elems} when is_list(elems) and length(elems) == 3 -> {:ok, 2}
      {:{}, _meta, elems} when is_list(elems) and length(elems) == 2 -> {:ok, 1}
      {_a, _b} -> {:ok, 1}
      _ -> :error
    end
  end
  ```
  This explicitly handles both the 3-tuple (`{name, "VERSION_REQ", opts}`)
  and 2-tuple (`{name, opts}`) dependency shapes — the exact crash gap #8
  describes is fixed in the current code.
- The doc's own later section (`gaps-to-fill-v26-9-1.md:297-316`) separately
  documents this same fix narratively ("`rewrite_dep_only/2` now only runs
  `collapse_empty_dep_opts/1`...") — i.e., the fix is documented further down
  in the same file, but the STATUS PASS summary block at the top
  (line 52-53) was not updated to match, and still marks gap #8 "OPEN,
  unaddressed."
- Line-number discrepancy note: the prior research pass that supplied this
  finding cited `dep_opts_elem/1` at `doctor_fixes.ex:340-369`; on-disk in
  this session the function is at `doctor_fixes.ex:400-409`, with
  `rewrite_dep_only/2` at `doctor_fixes.ex:357`. The substance of the finding
  (the fix exists, the STATUS PASS block is stale) is independently
  confirmed by direct file read in this session — only the exact line range
  cited by the prior pass has drifted, consistent with the file having been
  edited since that pass ran.

## Recommendation

1. **xaas**: Delete the dead pack between `xaas_ocel_envelope_pack` and
   `xaas_telemetry_pack` — confirm with the xaas maintainers which one is
   actually wired into their generation flow (`mix ggen_igniter.sync`
   invocation, CI, or `ggen_igniter` manifest) before deleting, since both
   currently produce the identical target path with no in-repo signal of
   which is authoritative.
2. **xaas / ggen_igniter (process)**: Add a same-target collision check to
   `ggen_igniter` pack validation (or a lightweight pre-sync lint in xaas)
   so two packs declaring the same `to:` path fail loudly instead of
   silently overwriting each other.
3. **ggen_igniter**: Correct the STATUS PASS block at
   `doc/gaps-to-fill-v26-9-1.md:52-53` to reflect that gap #8 is resolved
   (per the code at `lib/ggen_igniter/doctor_fixes.ex:357-409` and the doc's
   own later narrative at `gaps-to-fill-v26-9-1.md:297-316`), so the summary
   block stops contradicting the rest of the same document.
